evidence: Implements a new optional index in `src/index/txoscriptindex.{h,cpp}` alongside `OrderedVarInt` key formatting and updates to `txospenderindex`.
rationale: Adds a long-sought script index allowing pruned and full node operators to track script history. Script indexing resolves an architectural gap attempted since 2013 across PRs #2802, #3652, #6835, #10370, and #14053 to serve external indexers and Electrum servers without requiring wallet imports.
